changes: Kept the adult 2x3 photobooth concept and no-text constraint while replacing the thin-strap fitted sundress with a covered short-sleeve pink floral dress.

project_info.theme: adult pink-floral rose 2x3 film photobooth diary
project_info.color_palette: soft pink, pale rose, warm beige, cream, dark green, and flash amber

main_subject.description: An adult woman with shoulder-length black hair, soft volume, minimal natural makeup, fresh skin, and gentle lip tint.
main_subject.wardrobe: Pink floral short-sleeve midi dress with a modest square neckline and small red-pink scattered pattern.
main_subject.prop: One long-stem pale-pink rose with green leaves.
poses: Playful smile, holding the rose near the face with eyes gently closed.
Rose near the nose as if smelling it, relaxed soft smile.
Rose extended toward camera, gentle direct eye contact.
Candid laughter with slight hair motion, rose close to chest.
Shy giggle with one hand lightly near the mouth.
Calm smile with the rose held beside the ear.

composition_elements.framing: Equal 2x3 photobooth grid with the same adult woman, outfit, rose, and warm beige wall across six panels.
composition_elements.environment: Minimal cream-beige indoor wall with no text, date stamp, logo, or watermark.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Direct on-camera flash, warm white balance, slight halation, bright face highlights, and soft wall shadow.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Casual, candid, romantic, and early-2000s film-like.

technical_specs.quality: moderate depth, face sharp in each panel, tiny film softness, real grain, natural skin

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create one photoreal 4:5 2x3 photobooth-style collage of the same adult woman in all six equal panels. She has shoulder-length black hair with soft volume, minimal natural makeup, fresh skin, and wears a covered pink floral short-sleeve midi dress with a modest square neckline. Give her one long-stem pale-pink rose. Across the panels show: rose near face with eyes closed; smelling the rose; extending it toward camera; candid laughter with slight hair motion; shy giggle with one hand near mouth; and calm smile with rose beside ear. Use a warm cream-beige wall, direct on-camera flash, slight halation, warm film grain, 35mm snapshot softness, and no text, date stamps, logos, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, thin straps, fitted bodycon dress, revealing neckline, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, text, date stamp, logo, watermark, extra people, extra limbs, deformed hands, plastic skin

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All references are optional. Use them only to replace covered floral dress, rose type, wall color, or film-flash character; remove all text and branding.
